title: Want more features
body:
Comparing to other apps in the market, this app is very stable and beautiful but it lacks some useful features. To track the habit, I want the review page for monthly and weekly on calendar. Any habit should be possible to add tag so that it easily to filter and grouping. Last it should be able to schedule by counting the number in month or week randomly instead of only fixing day. For example, I want to create a habit of reviewing the material every monthly.

Thanks

title: Works for me
body: I have tried a few habit-keeping apps, in the end, Everyday is the one that stick and actually help me build a better habit. It’s simplicity and no-fuss design remove the distractions from the bells and dings and just hell me focus on keeping track of my habit. I particularly love the progressively dense colour as the habit streak is maintained.
